//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Stray Spawn -> Config

Enable Stray Spawn.//: Whether Stray Spawn is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

chanceSkeletonIsStray.//: The chance a skeleton that has spawned is of the stray variant. min: 0, max: 1

onlySpawnStraysOnSurface.//: When enabled, strays will only spawn on the surface.

dimensionsToSpawnIn.//: Dimensions in which skeletons can turn into strays, separated by a comma. Leave empty for every dimension. For example: 'minecraft:overworld,minecraft:the_nether'.

biomesToSpawnIn.//: Biomes in which skeletons can turn into strays, separated by a comma. Biome tags work too, starting with a '#'. Leave empty for every biome. For example: 'minecraft:snowy_plains,#minecraft:is_mountain'.
